title: The asterisk marker: 14 asterisked contractors, and a footnote that is not an award
why: The `*` is the only signal for small-business status and it is attached to the printed name. Two failure modes: stripping the asterisk out of contractor_raw (which breaks the raw string entity resolution keys on), and emitting the trailing `*Small business` legend as a 15th award.
verified_against: the announcement prose, by hand. Not verified against any model output -- cache/llm/ is empty.

checks.quote: The document body carries 15 asterisks. Fourteen are trailing markers on contractor names (Action Manufacturing Co.,* / Paligen Aerospace & Defense LLC,* / AAECON General Contracting LLC,* / Amerifield LLC,* / Huot Construction and Services Inc.,* / Red Eagle 3 JV,* / Semper Tek Inc.,* / Valiant Construction LLC,* / Tri Coast-Pac Tech JV 2,* / Argus Consulting Inc.,* / Enterprise Engineering Inc.,* / Robert and Co. Inc.,* / Aleut Construction LLC,* / Kit Masters Inc.,*); the fifteenth is the legend '*Small business' on the last line.
checks.reason: Counted by hand off the prose. See the `census` list on this case for the fourteen names.
small_business must be exactly the asterisked set -- no more (the footnote is not an award) and no fewer (the asterisk is easy to lose inside a pool).
The last line of the document is a legend explaining the marker. It has no dollar figure, no contract number and no contracting activity; it is not an award.

checks.quote: Action Manufacturing Co.,* Bristol, Pennsylvania, was awarded a $712,480,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract to manufacture, inspect, test, package and deliver M739A1 point detonating/delay fuzes. ... Army Contracting Command, Newark, New Jersey, is the contracting activity (W15QKN-26-D-A084).
checks.reason: contractor_raw is 'Action Manufacturing Co.,*' -- comma and asterisk included, exactly as printed. Not 'Action Manufacturing Co.' and not 'Action Manufacturing Co.,'.

checks.quote: Rockwell Collins Inc., Cedar Rapids, Iowa, was awarded a cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract
checks.reason: No asterisk is a positive statement that the entry is not marked small business, not an absence of information.

checks.quote: Rockwell Collins Inc., Cedar Rapids, Iowa, was awarded a cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for command, control and communications integration
checks.reason: The prose says 'Rockwell Collins Inc.'. Mapping it to RTX is the entity resolver's job on a different table; the extractor that does it here destroys the resolver's cache key.
